objective: Determine whether OpenClaw 2026.7.1 offers a supported Channel-layer pre-agent middleware that can protect the existing dedicated Feishu core route without changing its Binding.
allowed_scope: Read project reports and existing media tests
Read installed OpenClaw documentation, declarations, and distribution source
Write documentation-only evidence under reports and tasks
reason: The installed Plugin SDK has no Channel middleware hook for an existing Feishu channel. message_received is observation-only; inbound_claim is the only pre-routing decision hook and remains limited to plugin-owned conversation bindings. Core applies media understanding before the pre-agent message-hook emission.
